mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tie (tie_title, tie_content, tie_create_time, user_name, tie_image, tie_type, product_id) VALUES (#{tieTitle}, #{tieContent}, #{tieCreateTime}, #{userName}, #{tieImage}, #{tieType}, #{productId})
mapper.select: SELECT tie_id, tie_title, tie_content, tie_create_time, user_name, tie_image, tie_type, product_id FROM tie WHERE user_name = #{userName} AND (tie_image NOT LIKE '%|PENDING%' OR tie_image IS NULL) ORDER BY tie_create_time DESC
SELECT tie_id, tie_title, tie_content, tie_create_time, user_name, tie_image, tie_type, product_id FROM tie WHERE tie_image NOT LIKE '%|PENDING%' OR tie_image IS NULL ORDER BY tie_create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tie SET tie_image = #{tieImage} WHERE tie_id = #{tieId}
mapper.select: SELECT tie_id, tie_title, tie_content, tie_create_time, user_name, tie_image, tie_type, product_id FROM tie WHERE tie_image NOT LIKE '%|PENDING%' OR tie_image IS NULL ORDER BY tie_create_time DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT tie_id FROM tie WHERE user_name = #{userName} ORDER BY tie_create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tie SET tie_image = CONCAT(IFNULL(tie_image, ''), '|PENDING') WHERE tie_id = #{tieId}
